&nbsp;Job Position: Inventory and Record Officer
Job Location: Ijebu-mushin, Ogun
Employment Type: Contract&nbsp;

Job Summary


	Oversee daily site store operations, manage material stock levels, maintain precise inventory records, and track equipment usage to support smooth construction activities.


Key Responsibilities
Stock Management &amp; Record Keeping:


	Maintain up-to-date physical and digital logs of all inbound and outbound materials, tools, and machinery.
	Issue materials against approved site requisitions and obtain necessary signatures.
	Conduct periodic physical stock counts and reconcile balance records with physical inventory.


Receiving &amp; Inspection


	Receive incoming shipments from suppliers, verifying delivery notes against purchase orders for quantity and quality.
	Inspect goods upon delivery for damage or defects and report discrepancies immediately to management.
	Offload and organize incoming shipments systematically within the site store or yard.


Storage &amp; Safety:


	Ensure materials are stored securely, neatly, and according to safety regulations (e.g., proper stacking, hazardous material handling).
	Lock stores after operational hours and restrict unauthorized entry to prevent theft and vandalism.
	Maintain clean, organized store areas to minimize occupational hazards.


Reporting &amp; Coordination:


	Alert the Site Manager or Procurement Team when stock reaches reorder levels to prevent site delays.
	Prepare daily, weekly, or monthly inventory reports detailing material consumption, stock balance, and wastage.
	Monitor tool returns and schedule maintenance or repairs for damaged site equipment.


Salary
N150,000 per month.&nbsp;

Method of Application&nbsp;
Inetersted and qualified candidates should send their CV to: vineonyido@gmail.com using &quot;inventory and store keeper - Ogun&quot; as the subject of the email.",

With a focus on innovation, safety, and technical excellence, we provide end-to-end solutions that meet global standards and exceed client expectations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Inventory and Record Officer
Job Location: Ijebu-mushin, Ogun
Employment Type: Contract 

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Oversee daily site store operations, manage material stock levels, maintain precise inventory records, and track equipment usage to support smooth construction activities.


Key Responsibilities
Stock Management & Record Keeping:


	Maintain up-to-date physical and digital logs of all inbound and outbound materials, tools, and machinery.
	Issue materials against approved site requisitions and obtain necessary signatures.
	Conduct periodic physical stock counts and reconcile balance records with physical inventory.


Receiving & Inspection


	Receive incoming shipments from suppliers, verifying delivery notes against purchase orders for quantity and quality.
	Inspect goods upon delivery for damage or defects and report discrepancies immediately to management.
	Offload and organize incoming shipments systematically within the site store or yard.


Storage & Safety:


	Ensure materials are stored securely, neatly, and according to safety regulations (e.g., proper stacking, hazardous material handling).
	Lock stores after operational hours and restrict unauthorized entry to prevent theft and vandalism.
	Maintain clean, organized store areas to minimize occupational hazards.


Reporting & Coordination:


	Alert the Site Manager or Procurement Team when stock reaches reorder levels to prevent site delays.
	Prepare daily, weekly, or monthly inventory reports detailing material consumption, stock balance, and wastage.
	Monitor tool returns and schedule maintenance or repairs for damaged site equipment.


Salary
N150,000 per month.

Treasury Associate Job at Expedier




        
    

        
        Expedier is a digital financial platform on a mission to empower underserved individuals and businesses.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Treasury Associate
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time 

Role Summary
     

            
    




	The Treasury Associate supports the daily treasury operations of Expedier by monitoring account balances, processing treasury transactions, performing reconciliations, and assisting with liquidity management.
	The role ensures accurate records, timely transaction execution, and effective coordination with banks, payment partners, and internal teams.


Key Responsibilities


	Monitor daily balances across bank accounts, wallets, and payment platforms.
	Process approved treasury transfers, account funding, and top-ups.
	Support the execution and tracking of OTC and offline transactions.
	Perform daily reconciliations of bank, wallet, and partner accounts.
	Follow up on pending transactions, settlements, and funding requests.
	Prepare weekly treasury balance and transaction reports
	Maintain accurate treasury records and supporting documentation.
	Liaise with banks, payment processors, and liquidity partners on operational matters.
	Escalate liquidity shortages, reconciliation issues, and transaction exceptions promptly.
	Support treasury process improvement and compliance initiatives.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Banking & Finance, or a related field.
	1–2 years of experience in Treasury, Finance, Banking Operations, or Reconciliation.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
	Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
	Good communication and organizational skills.
	Ability to work accurately under pressure and meet deadlines.


Salary
N311,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their Resume / CV to: [email protected] using "Application for [Role]  Internship – Full Name" as the subject of the mail (eg Application for Treasury Associate– Jane Doe).

	Support daily operational activities and administrative tasks.

	Professional handling of guests and visitors.

	Timely response to inquiries and guest concerns.
	Smooth coordination with operational departments.
	Maintenance of luxury hospitality standards at the front desk.

Head, Sales & Revenue Job at Sterling Gate Services Limited




        
    

        
        Sterling Gate Services Limited is an indigenous consulting firm established in 2017, providing structured and tailored support to organisations across multiple sectors. We partner with companies strengthening HR functions, recruiting top talent, and managing facilities, office supplies, catering, and general support services, aligned with business objectives and professional best practices. Supporting People, Places & Processes. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Head, Sales & Revenue

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are looking for a sound commercially driven sales leader to take ownership of revenue generation channels and build a high-performing sales function.
	This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who knows how to find opportunities, build a pipeline, close deals and turn commercial strategy into measurable revenue.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute the sales and revenue growth strategy.
	Own revenue targets, sales pipeline and conversion.
	Identify and develop new business opportunities and revenue streams.
	Lead acquisition of clients, merchants and commercial partners.
	Build and manage a high-performing sales team.
	Drive partnerships that translate into measurable commercial value.
	Establish sales processes, targets, reporting and performance standards.
	Track market trends, customer needs and competitive opportunities.
	Provide regular revenue forecasts and performance reports to management.
	Develop strategies to improve customer acquisition, retention and revenue.


We’re Looking For


	Proven experience in sales leadership, business development or revenue management.
	Strong track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
	Excellent negotiation, pitching and relationship-management skills.
	Commercially minded, strategic and highly results-oriented.
	Industry experience in technology, digital platforms, fintech, e-commerce, media, telecommunications, hospitality, tourism or other fast-moving consumer/business services.
	Strong leadership and team-building ability.
	Experience in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment.
	Ability to turn opportunities into actual revenue, not just conversations.


Salary
N1,000,000 per month.

Note: If you are a closer, builder and commercially minded leader who thrives on targets and measurable results, we'd love to hear from you.
